mappings.control_strategy: Use the editorial archetype with the phrase '8K masterpiece' present while holding all visible scene instructions constant.
mappings.variant_strategy: Remove only the phrase '8K masterpiece'; retain the rest of the prompt including 'ultra-detailed' so the ablation is narrowly scoped.
mappings.single_factor_guard: The generated control and variant prompts must differ only by the literal '8K masterpiece' phrase.

mappings.control_strategy: Append a broad generic negative stack to the narrative restoration-studio archetype.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only that stack with two targeted constraints tied to visible risks: hand distortion around the tray and unintended readable text on archival tags.
mappings.single_factor_guard: Scene content, action, lighting, composition, and positive instructions remain byte-identical outside the negative-constraint clause.

mappings.control_strategy: Append a stack of affectively similar emotion adjectives to the otherwise frozen narrative archetype.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only the adjective stack with one precise emotional direction expressing restrained anticipation and uncertainty.
mappings.single_factor_guard: No scene facts, action, camera, lighting, or environment content may change with the emotion clause.

mappings.control_strategy: Use the stylized key-art archetype as a readable natural-language production brief.
mappings.variant_strategy: Encode the same subject, action, environment, lighting, composition, rendering, and exclusions as JSON-style structured text without adding or deleting semantic requirements.
mappings.single_factor_guard: A fixed semantic-anchor list must be present in both prompts; only representation format may differ.

mappings.control_strategy: Keep the fashion archetype's generic 'deep teal satin evening dress' wording.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only that garment phrase with construction details while preserving dress type, color, satin material, and scene.
mappings.single_factor_guard: The control and variant must differ only in the garment-description span.

mappings.control_strategy: Use the frozen mid-turn fashion archetype without explicit fabric-response mechanics.
mappings.variant_strategy: Append one fabric-response sentence describing lag, waist tension folds, and modest trailing hem motion.
mappings.single_factor_guard: The only added information is how the already-present satin dress responds to the already-present turn.

mappings.control_strategy: Use the same project-owned identity fixture with a deliberately redundant multi-sentence identity lock.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace the redundant lock block with one precise identity-only instruction while holding the fixture and all target-scene instructions constant.
mappings.single_factor_guard: The same exact identity fixture must be attached to every replicate; only lock repetition changes.
fixture_requirements: one project-owned identity fixture with stable provenance and a frozen file hash

mappings.control_strategy: Provide the same three project-owned references with an implicit instruction to preserve identity, outfit, and pose, but do not assign which reference controls which role.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only the opening reference instruction with explicit identity-only, outfit-only, and pose-only role declarations.
mappings.single_factor_guard: Reference files, ordering, target scene, and all non-role prompt text must remain identical.
fixture_requirements: frozen file hashes and reference ordering

mappings.control_strategy: Keep one explicit modern electric desk-lamp phrase in the Ming study while also appending a post-hoc instruction to avoid modern electrical objects.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only the conflicting modern object with a period-compatible ceramic oil lamp; retain the same final constraint sentence in both conditions.
mappings.single_factor_guard: The single positive object phrase is the only textual difference; all composition, wardrobe, lighting, and negative constraints are otherwise unchanged.
